metadata.question: In the Norwegian Sea during Septermber 1, 2019, is the water color at (50.282684, -58.944881) more milky than (50.415337, -54.128047)?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to analyze water color/turbidity in the Norwegian Sea on September 1, 2019 - Water color/turbidity can be assessed using Sentinel-2 true color or turbidity indices - "Milky" water typically indicates higher turbidity/sediment content - Use Sentinel-2 for water quality assessment - Date: September 1, 2019 (single day or small window) - Locations: Two points to compare 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds as we want clear water observations - Use QA60 band for cloud masking in Sentinel-2 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid result: Both points have data, can calculate turbidity/reflectance values - C1: No images found for the date/location - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels after cloud masking - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - Compare turbidity values: Higher turbidity = more milky ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point1 = ee.Geometry.Point([50.282684, -58.944881]); const point2 = ee.Geometry.Point([50.415337, -54.128047]); const date = '2019-09-01'; const dateStart = ee.Date(date); const dateEnd = dateStart.advance(3, 'day'); // 2. Data Acquisition const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd) .filterBounds(point1.union(point2)); const size = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Total images found: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-2 images found. Trying wider date range...'); const dateEnd2 = dateStart.advance(7, 'day'); const collection2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd2) .filterBounds(point1.union(point2)); const size2 = await collection2.size().getInfo(); if (size2 === 0) { console.log('No data available.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Cloud masking function function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(cloudMask); } const masked = collection.map(maskClouds); const image = masked.median(); // 4. Calculate turbidity using Red band (B4) as proxy for milky/turbid water const turbidity = image.select('B4'); // 5. Extract values at both points const stats1 = await turbidity.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: point1.buffer(100), scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = await turbidity.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: point2.buffer(100), scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const val1 = stats1.B4; const val2 = stats2.B4; console.log(`Point1 (50.28, -58.94) turbidity: ${val1}`); console.log(`Point2 (50.42, -54.13) turbidity: ${val2}`); // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (val1 === null || val1 === undefined) { console.log('Point1: No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (val2 === null || val2 === undefined) { console.log('Point2: No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (isNaN(val1) || isNaN(val2)) { console.log('Calculation failed - NaN result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Higher reflectance in red band indicates more turbid/milky water if (val1 > val2) { console.log('Point1 is more milky than Point2.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Point1 is NOT more milky than Point2.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
